order_001.subject: Need ethyl bromide for polymer synthesis
order_001.message: Our group is starting a new alkylation series this week and we're short on ethyl bromide. Could you supply 0.5 mol? Crude is fine -- we're distilling it ourselves before use. Payment on delivery, as usual.

order_002.subject: Pure ethyl cyanide needed ASAP
order_002.message: My qualifying exam project needs 0.3 mol of pure ethyl cyanide -- no crude, it has to be clean for the follow-up step. I know it's short notice, but I'd really appreciate it if you could get this out soon. Happy to pay a premium.

order_003.subject: Restocking crude propionic acid
order_003.message: Stockroom's running low on propionic acid again. We just need the crude form for general use -- 1.0 mol should hold us for a couple of weeks. Drop it off whenever you can get to it.

order_004.subject: Pure ethyl propionate for tasting panel
order_004.message: We're prepping samples for next week's tasting panel and need 0.4 mol of pure ethyl propionate -- any trace of the crude byproducts throws off the profile, so it has to be clean. Reward reflects the rush.

order_005.subject: Pure acetonitrile for solvent trial
order_005.message: We're running a solvent trial that calls for 0.6 mol of pure acetonitrile -- water content has to be as low as possible, so please make sure it's fully purified before shipping.
